question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product
description: The mass fraction of renewable materials out of the total product mass (expressed following range 1 defined in 6.2) refers to the proportion of renewable materials in the product, excluding book and claim models. This statement is mandatory and requires public availability of the data. It is part of the ISO 59040:2025 standard for sustainable construction.
